case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to St. Joseph's pier.** It's the best of the four for pier salmon, but that's a weak edge: expect a slow day with a few fish.
- **Pier rating for this week, 0-4:**
  - St. Joseph: 1 (below average)
  - South Haven: 1 (low confidence, no pier data)
  - Grand Haven: 0 (slow)
  - Muskegon: 0 (slow)
- **If you want better odds, fish a boat.** Boats were rated 2-3 at Grand Haven and South Haven, with fish 55-110 ft down in 120-210 ft of water and spoons or flies.
- **Lures for the pier:** I have no pier-specific lure reports this month, so I can't recommend one. Spoons were the most-reported lure for boats.

## Why

- St. Joseph is the best guess because the Sept 14 report had boats at the pier heads catching "a couple of coho and Chinook," which beats the slow pier reports at Grand Haven and Muskegon.
- Grand Haven and Muskegon get 0 because the pier was "slow for salmon" at Grand Haven on both Sept 7 and Sept 14, and no salmon were reported from the Muskegon breakwalls on Sept 7.
- South Haven gets a low-confidence 1 because none of its four recent reports mention a pier, so I'd expect pier fishing there to be about as slow as the rest, but I can't confirm it.
- Boats are the better bet because the Sept 14 Grand Haven and Sept 7 South Haven reports rated boat fishing 3 (good).

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (last 4 weeks, newest Sept 14, 2022, six days before today)
- Grand Haven, Sept 14: boats got "decent" action 55-110 ft down in 120-210 ft of water, rated 3. Pier: "The pier action was slow for salmon," rated 0.
- Grand Haven, Sept 7: boat action "fair" in 40-120 ft, rated 2. Pier: "slow for salmon," rated 0.
- Muskegon, Sept 14: boats got salmon 55-100 ft down in 100-200 ft, rated 1. No pier report.
- Muskegon, Sept 7: boats rated 2 (45-90 ft down). Pier: "No salmon were reported from the breakwalls," rated 0.
- St. Joseph, Sept 14: "a couple of boats fishing the pier heads and caught a couple of coho and Chinook," rated 1. No pier-only report.
- St. Joseph, Aug 24: "Salmon anglers had slow fishing. There seemed to be a few fish around the piers," rated 1.
- South Haven, Sept 14: boat fishing "decent," rated 2, best water around 110 ft on spoons. Sept 7: boats rated 3, with fish in 110-120 ft and "some good fish caught deeper." No pier reports.

**Past seasons**
- The similar-weeks lookup (about 70 F surface water, within 21 days) returned only the same 2022 reports above. It gave me no independent history, so I have no past-season evidence for this week.

**Conditions now**
- Buoy surface water this week: St. Joseph 70 F (-1 F over the week), South Haven 71 F (flat), Grand Haven 71 F (flat), Muskegon 71 F (flat) (measured buoy data, Sept 13-20 week).
- The conditions tool returned a backtest summary, not live data. It had no modeled pierhead temperature, no upwelling trend, and no wind forecast, so I can't say whether an upwelling is bringing fish to the piers.

## Caveats

- The newest report is six days old (Sept 14), and the fall season changes fast. Treat these ratings as a guide.
- Surface temperatures are measured from buoys miles offshore. The pier-specific signal (modeled pierhead temperature and any upwelling) was not available.
- South Haven and St. Joseph have little or no recent pier-specific reporting, so their pier ratings are the least certain.
- Check the wind before you go. The conditions tool gave no forecast; if winds are strong from the north or east, that's worth a look for pier safety and for any upwelling.

## Sources

- Sept 14, 2022 DNR report (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/32cff90
- Sept 7, 2022 DNR report (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/32bbcf0
- Aug 24, 2022 DNR report (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3298204
